title: Square
statementMd:
There is a square painted on a piece of paper, the square's side equals $*n*$ meters. John Doe draws crosses on the square's perimeter. John paints the first cross in the lower left corner of the square. Then John moves along the square's perimeter in the clockwise direction (first upwards, then to the right, then downwards, then to the left and so on). Every time he walks $(*n* + 1)$ meters, he draws a cross (see picture for clarifications).

John Doe stops only when the lower left corner of the square has two crosses. How many crosses will John draw?

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1a5106013b56c4563d9e80e6baa0b5b32ba57175.png) The figure shows the order in which John draws crosses for a square with side $4$. The lower left square has two crosses. Overall John paints $17$ crosses.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*t*$ ($1 ≤ *t* ≤ 10^{4}$) — the number of test cases.

The second line contains $*t*$ space-separated integers $*n*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *n*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the sides of the square for each test sample.

## Output

For each test sample print on a single line the answer to it, that is, the number of crosses John will draw as he will move along the square of the corresponding size. Print the answers to the samples in the order in which the samples are given in the input.

Please do not use the `%lld` specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specifier.
statementZhMd:
纸上画着一个正方形，正方形的边长为 $*n*$ 米。John Doe 在正方形的周长上画十字。John 首先在正方形的左下角画一个十字。然后，John 沿正方形的周长顺时针移动（先向上，再向右，然后向下，再向左，如此循环）。每走 $(*n* + 1)$ 米，他就画一个十字（具体情况请参见图片）。

只有当正方形的左下角有两个十字时，John Doe 才会停止。John 总共会画多少个十字？

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1a5106013b56c4563d9e80e6baa0b5b32ba57175.png) 图片展示了边长为 $4$ 的正方形中，John 画十字的顺序。正方形的左下角有两个十字。John 总共画了 $17$ 个十字。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*t*$（$1 ≤ *t* ≤ 10^{4}$）——测试用例的数量。

第二行包含 $*t*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*n*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *n*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——每个测试用例中正方形的边长。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，在单独一行中输出答案，即 John 沿着对应大小的正方形移动时将画出的十字数量。请按照输入中给出的测试用例顺序输出答案。

请不要在 C++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流或 `%I64d` 格式说明符。
